sets.relationshipLabel: thing and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: An envelope always has a flap and a stamp always has a perforation — each pair names a whole and a physical part it inherently possesses.

sets.relationshipLabel: place and the activity it exists for
sets.explanation: A pillar box exists for collection and a sorting office exists for distribution — each place is defined by the single job it was built to do.
A postmark necessarily announces a dispatch date and a frank necessarily announces postage paid — each mark is proof of the fact, not just a hint at it.

sets.relationshipLabel: action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: Return undoes send and recall undoes dispatch — both pairs are opposite actions where the second cancels the first's effect.
